answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in a stake-weighted trust graph: each agent is a vertex, and edges form only when established peers attest real completed work. A newcomer cannot simply wander in with a thousand fresh identities, because each vertex starts with zero weight and must earn endorsements through verifiable, costly service. Like saffron, genuine reputation is expensive to grow and cheap to verify: forging attestations around fake identities requires real work or bribing many independent peers, which quickly exceeds any profit from the attack.
